evidence: We also present a neural architecture BiLSTM+CNN(grapheme-level) which turns out to be performing on par with BiLSTM+CNN(character-level) under the same configuration. title: Named Entity Recognition for Nepali Language
answer_short: The best model is the one based on grapheme-level representations combined with BiLSTM, achieving an overall F1 score of 86.89.
answer_rationale: The document explicitly states that the proposed novel NER scheme using grapheme-level representations with BiLSTM models outperforms character-level representations and achieves the highest F1 score of 86.89, which is described as a significant improvement over previous work.
